purpose: Declare existing in-code owner guards, not grant permissions or activate protocols
route_target_correction: Eight personal routes previously named AuthController but resolved P10 through the existing container binding. They now target P10ProfileController directly; effective handler and wire contracts remain unchanged.

guards.all: auth:api, fresh active actor, no caller-provided actor/permission override
guards.presented_family: P10 validates a sid-bearing token's current family; existing legacy access-only policy is unchanged
guards.avatar: Current actor only; immutable owner lookup. Mutation uses existing If-Match, file whitelist and profile transaction
guards.preferences: Current actor only; strict body/query allowlist, version/CAS and audit on write
guards.devices: Current live stable family; caller-owned installation/family queries; foreign device is 404; current device/family protected
guards.history: Current actor only, ended login families ranked before pagination; no caller identity filter
guards.p11: Existing explicit contract/schema/flag gate remains OFF unless separately released; actor/exact operation key scope; another active family needs existing credential/MFA proof; revoked tokens never gain access

inventory.matching: Exact method, URI, concrete class and action; method must exist and route must retain auth:api

notification_rollout.user_decision: Business notification delivery enabled on DEV/TEST after release; no production
notification_rollout.normal_mode_selector: NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_CANARY_FILE empty; closed policy and old spent budget/receipt retained
notification_rollout.old_test_binding: REVOKED at historical binding v1, installation v2; do not reactivate or reuse it
notification_rollout.old_backlog_gate: Refuse activation if PENDING/RETRYABLE/CONFIGURATION_ERROR/SENDING rows exist; never replay UNKNOWN or old TEST
notification_rollout.owner_requirement: Legitimate current web/Android owner registers through existing client consent/proof/version protocol; no support takeover
